get_supported_openai_params: get the list of OpenAI parameters supported by a Perplexity model
transform_response: transform a Perplexity API response into a standardized ModelResponse with enhanced usage and citations
enhance_usage_with_perplexity_fields: enhance a ModelResponse usage object with Perplexity-specific fields like citation tokens and search queries
add_citations_as_annotations: extract citation markers from Perplexity response text and attach them as URL citation annotations
get_openai_compatible_provider_info: resolve Perplexity API base URL and API key from arguments or environment variables
